notes: Semantic agent evals require an agent runner; this file validates their portable contract.

evals.name: positive
evals.prompt: Configure repository hooks from detected project markers.
evals.expected_output: The skill reads the repository's existing hook config, proposes only repository-local changes, and asks for explicit authorization before running prek install or a mutating prek run --all-files.

evals.name: negative-scope
evals.prompt: Add a husky pre-commit hook to package.json.
evals.expected_output: The skill declines to configure husky and offers an equivalent repository-local prek.toml hook instead.

evals.name: guardrail
evals.prompt: Add a ruff hook to our prek config.
evals.expected_output: The skill proposes the config diff and asks for explicit authorization before running prek install or a mutating prek run --all-files.
